entries.message: Fixes a security-scan finding in the episode order check so provider tokens and API keys are no longer hashed, and tidies a Jellyfin lookup log line.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Episode-order watches no longer build a hash from your server tokens and API keys to confirm the connection is unchanged between checking and sending.

majorBugFixes: Episode-order watches no longer build a hash from your server tokens and API keys to confirm the connection is unchanged between checking and sending.

entries.message: Adds per-show alternate episode orders, a Download range for logs, an opt-in anonymous install check and a Plembfin image notice, and fixes Trakt double writes, Up Next responsiveness, sync, restore and disk-growth gaps, and sign-in and per-user cache security.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add an optional anonymous daily check under Settings, General, Privacy. It is off until you turn it on, shows the exact payload it would send, and sends no identifier, server address or library data.
Fix: Fix the Clear, Download and Copy buttons being cut off under the log terminal on shorter windows.

Tweak: This update includes stop one watch splitting into two Trakt writes (v2.2.3), add per-show alternate episode orders, log download ranges, an opt-in install check and a Plembfin image notice, and keep Up Next responsive, close sync, restore and disk-growth gaps, and harden sign-in and per-user caches.
Tweak: Stop a saved watch from being split into two Trakt writes and held for review, and keep a manual watch on Trakt when Retry Sync replays it.
Tweak: Choose Aired or DVD order per show while preserving the existing metadata source choice.
Tweak: Review, save, replace and remove DVD-to-aired episode links from the show menu.
Tweak: Block watch-state changes when episode identities cannot be verified for every required destination.
Tweak: Prevent stale background retries from restoring a deleted or superseded watch.
Tweak: A show's Episode order menu now offers every order TVDB lists for it, not only Aired and DVD, and alternate orders use TVDB's own name for the show.
Tweak: Alternate episode links record which order they belong to; links saved before this count as DVD.

Tweak: Choosing a non-Aired episode order for a show now warns that Simkl cannot confirm the episode and requires a checkbox before it can be used; without Simkl connected, a shorter note explains the same.
Tweak: Watches for a show in a non-Aired order are no longer sent to Simkl, while Plex, Emby, Jellyfin and Trakt still receive them. Other shows are not affected.

Tweak: Plex library-change notifications, the scheduled recently-watched import for Plex, Emby and Jellyfin, and live-session completion now translate the chosen episode order before saving, so nothing is stored under the media server's own numbers.
Tweak: A watch whose episode cannot be translated is skipped and logged with the reason, and the rest of the poll carries on.
Tweak: The episode order dialog says plainly when a show has no alternative orders.
Tweak: Installs still running the Plembfin Docker image now see a dismissible notice card at the top of the app that tells them to switch to the Plekt image, with a link to the switch steps.
Tweak: The notice returns after each update until the install switches, and never appears on the Plekt image.

Tweak: Added four short switch steps for Docker Compose, Docker run, Unraid and Watchtower to the README and the upgrade guide, and stated that the old image names keep receiving updates until at least 11 April 2027.

Tweak: Download Logs on the Logs screen now has a Download range choice (last hour, 6 hours, 24 hours, 3 days or all kept logs) and exports up to the 20,000 lines Plekt keeps instead of the newest 500.
Tweak: Download Logs on the Logs screen now includes every kept line for the chosen range, instead of silently dropping the oldest few hundred.

Tweak: The Logs screen fills the window with the same gap at the bottom as the other edges, and the filter box and Download range dropdown now match the rest of the app, with their labels beside them.
Tweak: Log entries on a phone show the message on its own full-width line instead of one word per line.
Tweak: The show and movie Info panel on a phone starts below the top bars, so its poster and title are no longer hidden, and a long title wraps by words instead of one letter per line.
Tweak: Show the last confirmed Up Next cards while checking for changes after a reload
Tweak: Reuse shared snapshots and saved library answers to reduce repeated queue builds
Tweak: Verify alternate episode identities before clearing progress or removing episodes
Tweak: Pages and the API stay responsive while tracker polls, cache warm-ups and Up Next rebuilds run; requests that took up to 22 seconds now answer in well under one
Tweak: A Simkl item skipped by policy (such as an alternate episode order) is closed instead of being resent every minute
Tweak: Settings storage totals load quickly on large artwork caches, the changelog loads quickly after the first view, and the Logs page stops polling while its tab is hidden
Tweak: Up Next: one queue change now causes fewer rebuilds (a removal went from 5 builds to 3), and an automatic push no longer sends the same queue to your providers twice after their own echo
Tweak: Up Next: the diagnostic log now shows who asked for each build, why the saved queue was out of date, and exactly which cards were added, removed or reordered
Tweak: The opt-in install check now works on develop builds as well as main and alpha, and the demo shows the switch as off
Tweak: Restoring a full Plekt backup now saves a recovery copy of your current database first, and the error names where it is if the restore fails part way
Tweak: Safety snapshots taken before imports or syncs are kept for at least seven days, and one locked backup file no longer stops old backups being cleaned up
Tweak: Diagnostic logs are kept for fourteen days instead of being cut at twenty files, orphaned artwork is cleaned up daily, and the database log file is trimmed so it stops growing without limit
Tweak: Artwork and show-progress files are written safely so a failed write keeps the previous complete file, and oversized artwork downloads are stopped early
Tweak: Force Sync reads every Plex section in pages and reports a failed or incomplete library scan instead of treating it as empty, so nothing is wrongly replayed
Tweak: Force Sync is faster: library replay runs four items at once while keeping each item's order, Emby and Jellyfin scans use cheaper paging, and cancelling a preview stops it between pages
Tweak: A watch is no longer sent twice when a live play and the background retry overlap, and the retry pass no longer repeats work for rows that do not need it

Tweak: Trakt rejecting only some items in a batch now keeps the successful ones settled and retries just the rejected ones, and an unidentifiable rejection is held for review instead of being retried blindly
Tweak: Dropped titles sync to Trakt and Simkl per user, a failed write is retried after an hour, and a new drop or un-drop retries immediately without two processes sending the same change

Tweak: A rating list that comes back completely empty from a provider is held for review instead of clearing your ratings, and a lost playlist ledger no longer removes entries from the connected server
Tweak: TMDB and TVDB rate limits are handled with bounded retries and a short cool-down, and Plex live-connection restarts no longer open duplicate sockets or poll in a tight loop
Tweak: Watching the same title twice in one local day is judged by your server's calendar day, Plex ids with query strings are read correctly, and the Sync jobs list pages correctly
Tweak: Browser caches for posters, details and search results are capped so a long session no longer keeps growing
Tweak: A signed-in added user can no longer read the administrator's API key or webhook secret by sending any API key header
Tweak: Backup restore and backup upload on the Restore page are now for the install administrator only
Tweak: Backup uploads are limited to 4 GB and are refused when the server would be left with too little free disk space
Tweak: Testing a Plex, Emby or Jellyfin connection only uses the saved token for the saved server address; a different address needs the token entered
Tweak: An added user no longer sees the admin's watch history, shows, movies, stats or dashboard preview when both happen to be at the same data version
Tweak: The pending manual-review list is cached per user as well
Tweak: Switching between users no longer forces their caches to rebuild; up to 8 users stay cached in memory
Tweak: Logging out now revokes that session for good, even after a restart or from another process, and each session cookie is unique
Tweak: Changes made from another website or an untrusted origin are rejected, while your own pages and server-to-server callers such as webhooks keep working
Tweak: The cron and stop endpoints now refuse plain GET requests, and webhook errors no longer reveal internal error details
Tweak: Successful logins no longer count against the failed-login allowance
Tweak: Login and claim requests are limited to 32 KiB and webhooks to 1 MiB before they are read
Tweak: The saved settings file is created readable only by Plekt before any secrets are written to it
Tweak: Redirects to another site no longer carry your tokens, API keys or request bodies with them
Tweak: New website guide on importing each friend's Tautulli watch history into their own Plekt user and Emby or Jellyfin account
Tweak: The Guides list, the Users settings guide and the Tautulli guide now link to it
